about.description:
CppInterOp exposes API from Clang and LLVM in a backward compatibe way.
The API support downstream tools that utilize interactive C++ by using
the compiler as a service. That is, embed Clang and LLVM as a libraries
in their codebases. The API are designed to be minimalistic and aid
non-trivial tasks such as language interoperability on the fly. In such
scenarios CppInterOp can be used to provide the necessary introspection
information to the other side helping the language cross talk.
about.summary:
The CppInterOp library provides a minimalist approach for other languages
to interoperate with C++ entities.

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: cppinterop
  build_number: 0
  version: 2.0.0

package:
  name: cppinterop
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/compiler-research/CppInterOp/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 59c1118a02edd1b1a69b5ea2f223b849bc5f1cb51abec40930d33f432f7f1260
    patches:
      - patches/use-native-tablegen-target.patch
      - patches/link-testdownstreamlib-with-dl.patch
      - patches/ppc64le-indirect-glibc-calls.patch
      - patches/forward-macos-target-to-benchmark.patch
    target_directory: cppinterop

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  string: clang${{ clangdev | default('None') | split('.') | first }}_repl_h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}

requirements:
  build:
    - cmake
    - if: unix
      then: make
    - if: win
      then: ninja
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - llvm ${{ clangdev }}
    - llvmdev ${{ clangdev }}
    - clangdev ${{ clangdev }}
    - libxml2-devel
    - zlib
    - git-lfs
  host:
    - llvm ${{ clangdev }}
    - llvmdev ${{ clangdev }}
    - clangdev ${{ clangdev }}
    - if: unix and x86_64
      then: backtrace
    - libxml2-devel
    - zlib
    - zstd
  run:
    # clang_bootstrap has no run-export
    - if: osx
      then: libcxx >=${{ cxx_compiler_version }}
  run_exports:
    - ${{ pin_subpackage(name, upper_bound='x.x') }}
  ignore_run_exports:
    by_name:
      - libxml2-devel
      - backtrace
      - libllvm${{ clangdev | default('None') | split('.') | first }}
  run_constraints:
    - llvm ${{ clangdev }}
    - llvmdev ${{ clangdev }}
    - clangdev ${{ clangdev }}

tests:
  - package_contents:
      files:
        - if: win
          then: Library/bin/clangCppInterOp.dll
          else:
            - if: osx
              then: lib/libclangCppInterOp.dylib
              else: lib/libclangCppInterOp.so
  - files:
      recipe:
        - CMakeLists.txt
        - test.cpp
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - clang ${{ clangdev }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
    script:
      - if: build_platform != target_platform
        then: exit 0
      - mkdir -p cmake_build_test && pushd cmake_build_test
      - if: unix
        then: $CXX -xc++ -E -v /dev/null 2>&1 | sed -n -e '/^.include/,${' -e '/^ \/.*/p' -e '}'
      - cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCONDA_PREFIX="$BUILD_PREFIX" -G "Ninja" ..
      - cmake --build . --config Debug -- -v
      - if: unix
        then: ./cmake_build_test $CXX
      - rm -fr *
      - cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCONDA_PREFIX="$BUILD_PREFIX" -G "Ninja" ..
      - cmake --build . --config Release
      - if: unix
        then: ./cmake_build_test $CXX
      - rm -fr *
      - cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo -DCONDA_PREFIX="$BUILD_PREFIX" -G "Ninja" ..
      - cmake --build . --config RelWithDebInfo
      - if: unix
        then: ./cmake_build_test $CXX
      - popd

about:

  license_file: cppinterop/LICENSE.txt
  summary: |
    The CppInterOp library provides a minimalist approach for other languages
    to interoperate with C++ entities.
  description: |
    CppInterOp exposes API from Clang and LLVM in a backward compatibe way.
    The API support downstream tools that utilize interactive C++ by using
    the compiler as a service. That is, embed Clang and LLVM as a libraries
    in their codebases. The API are designed to be minimalistic and aid
    non-trivial tasks such as language interoperability on the fly. In such
    scenarios CppInterOp can be used to provide the necessary introspection
    information to the other side helping the language cross talk.
  homepage: https://github.com/compiler-research/CppInterOp
  repository: https://cppinterop.readthedocs.io/en/${{ version }}/DevelopersDocumentation.html
  documentation: https://cppinterop.readthedocs.io/en/${{ version }}

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - JohanMabille
    - alexander-penev
    - vgvassilev
